import json, os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
cases=[('zero',{'a':0,'b':0},0),('negative',{'a':-7,'b':2},-5),('fraction',{'a':1.25,'b':2.5},3.75),('missing',{'a':2},None),('wrong-type',{'a':'2','b':3},None),('extra',{'a':2,'b':3,'c':4},None)]
results=[]
for name,args,expected in cases:
 cmd=['npx','--yes','@mcpjam/cli@6.2.2','--no-telemetry','tools','call','--url','http://fixture:8765/mcp','--access-token',os.environ['MCP_SERVER_TOKEN'],'--tool-name','add','--tool-args',json.dumps(args),'--validate-response','--expect-success']
 p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True)
 (root/(name+'.json')).write_text(p.stdout)
 (root/(name+'.stderr')).write_text(p.stderr)
 try: data=json.loads(p.stdout)
 except ValueError: data={}
 ok=(p.returncode!=0 or data.get('isError') is True or 'error' in data) if expected is None else p.returncode==0 and data.get('structuredContent',{}).get('sum')==expected
 results.append({'name':name,'arguments':args,'expectedSum':expected,'expectRejection':expected is None,'exitCode':p.returncode,'passed':ok,'response':data})
(root/'edge-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if all(x['passed'] for x in results) else 1)
PY
python3 /workspace/validation/edge-cases.py
